latestApplications.name: GlucoWatch
latestApplications.summary: Dexcom or Nightscout glucose, chart and forecast on a Wear OS watch
latestApplications.description:
Shows your glucose on a Wear OS watch: the current value with a trend arrow, a chart across the whole round screen, and an optional forecast. It comes as a watch face, three tiles (glucose only; clock, glucose, heart rate and battery; and a light version), and an app, in GlucoseDAO colours. The face and both glucose-and-clock tiles also show your heart rate from the watch's own sensor.

The watch reads Dexcom Share or your own Nightscout directly. The optional GlucoPhone companion can relay readings over Bluetooth or copy the login to the watch. Download the phone APK from https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/glucowatch/releases and install it on the phone. The watch still works without it or any extra server. Dexcom readings need Share turned on in the official Dexcom app, with at least one follower.

For a Medtronic MiniMed pump, the watch can show CareLink glucose and insulin data. Sign in through the GlucoPhone companion, then choose "Get CareLink sign-in from phone" in watch Settings. CareLink is optional; Nightscout and demo data work without it. Phone ONNX forecasts can also be shown on the watch by choosing "Phone app model".

With Nightscout the watch also shows insulin and carbs on board from your loop (AAPS, Trio, iAPS, Loop), boluses and carbs on the chart, the last bolus and carbs, and the loop's own forecast. Nightscout works through API v1 or v3, with an access token or none for a public site.

This is not a medical device. Do not make treatment decisions from it. Keep using your CGM's official app and alarms.

Dexcom Share and CareLink are proprietary services read through undocumented interfaces, so a change on their side can stop that source until an update. Dexcom, Medtronic, MiniMed and CareLink are trademarks of their owners. GlucoWatch is not affiliated with them.

Install GlucoWatch on the watch. To use its watch face, install the separate GlucoWatch face package on the watch too. The app and tiles work without that face. The watch has no F-Droid app, and installing F-Droid on a phone does not copy these packages to the watch.

Download the watch app from its F-Droid page when available, or from https://github.com/GlucoseDAO/glucowatch/releases. Download the separate watch-face APK from its own F-Droid page when available, or from the same GitHub release. Each package is reviewed and published separately. On the watch, open Settings, About watch, Software information, and tap Software version 5 times. In Developer options, turn on ADB debugging and Wireless debugging. The watch and the computer have to be on the same Wi-Fi.

Open Wireless debugging, tap Pair new device, and note the IP address, the pairing port, and the 6-digit code. The main Wireless debugging screen shows a second port. That one is the connection port.

On a computer with Android platform-tools installed:

adb pair <watch-ip>:<pair-port>
adb connect <watch-ip>:<connect-port>
adb install -r <the app apk>
adb install -r <the watch face apk>

Open GlucoWatch, tap Settings, and choose Dexcom Share (username, password and region) or Nightscout (the site's address and, for a private site, an access token with the readable role). Tap Save & test. Long-press the current watch face, swipe to the end, tap Add watch face and choose GlucoWatch face. If a slot is empty, long-press the face, tap Customize, tap the slot, and choose Glucose or Glucose chart. For a tile, swipe left from the face to the end of the tiles, tap Add tiles and choose Glucose, Glucose, time and heart, or Glucose (light). For heart rate on the tile, tap Allow heart rate in GlucoWatch Settings.

Turn Wireless debugging off afterwards. It uses extra battery. A newer version is installed the same way: adb install -r replaces the copy already on the watch.

From a phone, download both APKs in the browser, install Wear Installer 2, pair it from the watch's Wireless debugging screen, and send each file with Custom APK.

latestApplications.name: DigitalValut Logos
latestApplications.summary: Encrypted peer-to-peer chat and calls. No account, no server, no phone number.
latestApplications.description: Peer-to-peer encrypted chat, voice and video calls, and file sharing — directly between two devices, with no account, no phone number, and no server that ever sees a message. Two browsers negotiate a private WebRTC connection and talk to each other directly. A small relay only ever helps them find each other and, when an unusually strict network requires it, forwards traffic that is already encrypted and which it has no key to read. There is no database anywhere holding conversations. The relay is a Cloudflare Worker run by the project (digitalvalut-turn.burbeng78.workers.dev); the connection helpers (STUN/TURN) are Cloudflare's (stun.cloudflare.com, turn.cloudflare.com). The relay address is fixed in the app. Its source is in the same repository (turn-worker/), so anyone can run their own, but using it means rebuilding the app. How you reach someone A permanent address (DV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) is the SHA-256 hash of a key pair generated on the device, so it verifies itself: whoever dials it fetches the published key, checks that it really hashes back to the address dialled, and only then trusts it. A substituted key produces a different address and is rejected. Up to eight throwaway addresses can be held alongside the permanent one, each revocable on its own. You can also connect by a tappable invite link, or by scanning a QR code in person. Knowing who you are really talking to The first time you connect to someone, both sides see the same three-word security code, derived from the actual cryptographic handshake — the same principle used by ZRTP-based secure calling. Read them aloud once; if they match, nobody is sitting in the middle. That check is bound to the other person's cryptographic fingerprint, not to a display name. What it does • Text, emoji, voice messages, photos, video and files up to 512 MB, sent uncompressed at original quality • Photos have their embedded GPS location, device model and software metadata stripped on-device before sending, without re-encoding the image • Audio and video calls with screen sharing • The phone rings even with the app closed, without Google and without Firebase: a service belonging to the app reads its own encrypted mailbox, and the question it asks has only yes or no for an answer. It holds no key and can read nothing; who is calling, and what they wrote, are read by the app when you open it. It uses more battery than a push notification would, and it is off until you turn it on • A sealed letter for someone who does not answer, held up to 7 days, openable only by the address owner • Self-destructing messages and optional automatic cleanup of old conversations • Interface in 13 languages, with right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu Honest limits Both people need to be online at the same time for a live conversation. That is the price of having no server, and it is architectural, not a bug. Your IP address is visible to the person you connect to, as it is in any direct peer-to-peer connection, unless you switch on "Hide where you are". About this package The entire application is inside this package. It is not a wrapper that opens a website: the app is served from the package's own storage, so what runs on your phone is what was built from the source in this repository, and it keeps working when the website cannot be reached at all. There is no push notification service anywhere in it — no Google Play Services, no Firebase, no account. The only background service is the app's own, described above, and it talks to nothing but the same relay the app already uses. Every cryptographic primitive comes from the system's own Web Crypto implementation. No third-party script, library or CDN resource is loaded at any point. Built by Associazione di Promozione Sociale DigitalValut, an Italian nonprofit. Free forever, with no account and nothing to buy.

latestApplications.name: RadioScout
latestApplications.summary: Free worldwide radio player. No accounts, no tracking
latestApplications.description:
F-Droid build: updates come from F-Droid only. Switching from the GitHub APK needs an uninstall + reinstall (different signature) — back up first via Settings → Data export, then import here.

RadioScout is a free worldwide radio player. Discover top stations by votes, search the full directory, filter by genre, country, language or bitrate, save favourites, track recent plays and listening stats — all on-device, no accounts, no sync, no tracking.

Features:
- 80,000+ stations from the community radio-browser directory (playable https streams only)
- Saved favourites with reorder, recent plays, listening trends and streaks
- Persistent player with crossfade, volume, per-station leveling, sleep timer
- Station sheets with art, tags, votes and shareable links
- One-file backup export/import for moving between devices
- Light/dark theme, quick-find palette, PWA install on desktop

Network: station data and votes use the radio-browser API; station logos load through wsrv.nl and proxy.duckduckgo.com; BBC and Radiolise track titles resolve through rms.api.bbc.co.uk and backend.radiolise.com; and the web version lives at radioscout.pages.dev.

Source, changelog and issue tracker on GitHub. MIT licensed.

featuredGames.name: Mindustry
featuredGames.summary: An open-ended factory management game with RTS and tower defense elements
featuredGames.description:
Mindustry is a factory-building game with tower defense and RTS elements. Create elaborate supply chains to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and construct units. Command units to capture enemy bases, and expand your production. Defend your core from waves of enemies.

Gameplay Features

- Use production blocks to create a wide variety of advanced materials - Defend your structures from waves of enemies - Play with your friends in cross-platform multiplayer co-op games, or challenge them in team-based PvP matches - Distribute liquids and fight constant challenges, like outbreaks of fire or enemy flier raids - Get the most out of your production by supplying optional coolant and lubricant - Produce a wide variety of units for automatic management of your base or assault on enemy bases - Set up assembly lines to construct armies of mechanized units - Use your units to square up against fully functional enemy bases

Campaign

- Conquer the planets Serpulo and Erekir as you advance through 35 hand-made maps and 250+ procedurally generated sectors - Capture territory and set up factories to produce resources while you play other sectors - Defend your sectors from periodic invasions - Coordinate resource distribution between sectors via launch pads - Research new blocks to fuel progress - Invite your friends to complete missions together - 250+ technology blocks to master - 50+ different types of drones, mechs and ships

Custom Games & Cross-Platform Multiplayer

- 16+ built in maps for custom games, in addition to two entire campaigns - Play co-op, PvP or sandbox - Join a public dedicated server, or invite friends to your own private session - Customizable game rules: Change block costs, enemy stats, starting items, wave timing and more - Full functional map editor with scripting support - Built-in mod browser & mod support

featuredGames.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
featuredGames.summary: A roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master!
featuredGames.description:
Shattered Pixel Dungeon is a traditional roguelike dungeon crawler RPG that's simple to get into but hard to master! Every game is a unique challenge, with six different heroes, randomized levels and enemies, and hundreds of items to collect and use. ShatteredPD is also updated with new content roughly every three months, so there's always something new.

Choose Your Hero

Each of ShatteredPD's six playable heroes has their own unique mechanics and gameplay style. Cut down foes as the durable Warrior or deadly Duelist, fry your enemies as the arcane Mage or divine Cleric, or use terrain to your advantage as the stealthy Rogue or the markswoman Huntress! As you progress through the dungeon you'll earn points to spend on talents, choose a subclass, and gain powerful lategame abilities. You can turn the Duelist into a dual-wielding Champion, the Cleric into a righteous Paladin, the Huntress into a precise Sniper, or explore loads of other possibilities!

Explore the Dungeon

ShatteredPD's dungeon is procedurally generated with random layouts, room types, items, traps, and enemies. In each game you'll find equipment and collect or craft consumable items to power you up or help you out in a pinch. There is a huge variety to what you might see from run to run and region to region. As you progress through the dungeon you'll find equipment that can be enchanted, upgraded, and augmented as you outfit your hero. Set foes ablaze with an enchanted weapon, wade through enemies with upgraded armor, or gain powerful damage, defensive, or utility benefits from one of the many magical wands, rings, artifacts, or trinkets.

Succeed or Die Trying

The Dungeon is filled with enemies, traps, hazards, and bosses intent on ending your run! Battle hostile wildlife in the sewers and caves, mad thieves and guards in the prison, occult servants in the fallen dwarven city, and maybe something even worse further down... All these hazards can make the game quite tough, but don't be discouraged! You probably won't win on your first try, but there are many tricks and strategies to discover and learn on the path to getting your first win. Afterward, there are optional challenges and achivements if you want to put your skills to the test!

Over A Decade in the Making

Shattered Pixel Dungeon is an open source game based on the source code of Pixel Dungeon by Watabou (first released in late 2012). It started in 2014 as a project to rebalance Pixel Dungeon but has steadily grown into its own game over the last 10 years! Features Include: • 6 Heroes, each with 2 subclasses, 3 endgame abilities, and over 25 talents. • Over 300 items including equipment, consumables, and items crafted via alchemy. • 5 dungeon regions, 26 floors, over 100 room types, and trillions of possible floor layouts. • Over 60 regular enemy types, 30 traps, and 10 bosses to test your skills. • An in-game catalog to fill in, with just over 500 entries. • 9 stackable challenges and over 100 achievements for completionists. • Interface modes for large and small screens, and support for multiple input types. • Updates roughly every 3 months with new content, fixes, and improvements. • Support for many languages thanks to the game's dedicated communities.

featuredGames.name: Unciv
featuredGames.description:
An open-source reimplementation of the most famous civilization-building game ever - fast, small, no ads, free forever!

Build your civilization, research technologies, expand your cities and defeat your foes!

Requests? Bugs? Want to help development? Todo list for the application is https://github.com/yairm210/Unciv/issues

Questions? Comments? Join us on discord at https://discord.gg/bjrB4Xw ;)

Want to help translating the game into your language? See https://yairm210.github.io/Unciv/Translating/Translating/

The world awaits! Will you build your civilization into an empire that will stand the test of time?

The 'have full network access' permission is required for user-initiated downloads and the multiplayer feature. All other listed permissions are included automatically by the API used to implement multiplayer turn notifications. Network permissions are used to list mods, download mods, download music and to upload/download multiplayer games. No other internet communication is initiated by Unciv.

featuredGames.name: Lichess
featuredGames.description:
Lichess is a free/libre, open-source chess application powered by volunteers and donations.
Today, Lichess users play more than five million games every day. Lichess is one of the most popular chess websites in the world while remaining 100% free.

Note: Push notifications are experimental and should not be expected to work correctly. To enable them, a Unified Push distributor such as https://f-droid.org/packages/org.unifiedpush.distributor.sunup/ needs to be installed.

The following features are available right now:
- play real time or correspondence chess
- play arena tournaments
- play against online bots
- solve chess puzzles from a wide variety of themes, online or offline
- race against the clock in Puzzle Storm
- analyse your games with latest Stockfish locally or on the server
- board editor
- study chess with a collaborative and interactive study feature
- learn board coordinates
- play over the board with a friend
- watch live chess broadcasts from all major chess tournaments
- watch Lichess TV and online streamers
- use a chess clock for your over the board games
- many different board themes and piece sets
- custom background themes
- system colours on Android 12+
- translated into 55 languages

featuredGames.name: Endless Sky
featuredGames.summary: Android port of endless-sky space trading game.
featuredGames.description:
This is a port of the endless-sky space trading game available at https://endless-sky.github.io/

Explore other star systems. Earn money by trading, carrying passengers, or completing missions. Use your earnings to buy a better ship or to upgrade the weapons and engines on your current one. Blow up pirates. Take sides in a civil war. Or leave human space behind and hope to find some friendly aliens whose culture is more civilized than your own...

Endless Sky is a sandbox-style space exploration game similar to Elite, Escape Velocity, or Star Control. You start out as the captain of a tiny space ship and can choose what to do from there. The game includes a major plot line and many minor missions, but you can choose whether you want to play through the plot or strike out on your own as a merchant or bounty hunter or explorer.

This port only supports english for now.

featuredGames.name: Daybook Puzzles: Daily Sudoku
featuredGames.summary: Daily sudoku, nonograms, word and logic puzzles. No ads, no account, offline.
featuredGames.description:
Daily Sudoku, killer sudoku, nonograms, word games and logic puzzles, free and with no ads. No account, no internet needed, and every past day is open from the start.

Every day brings a fresh set of classic pencil puzzles and brain games, each in three difficulties (Standard, Hard and Expert). The grid puzzles are built so they have exactly one answer you can reach by reasoning alone, with nothing to guess. Play one a day or as many as you like: a streak needs just one solve.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Sudoku, and Cage Sudoku (killer sudoku, with sum cages)
• Nonogram picture grids
• Futoshiki-style inequality grids, Shikaku rectangles, LITS, Tents and trees, Regions
• Kings, a Star Battle-style crown placement; Sun & Moon, a Takuzu-style binary grid; Atoms, Hashi-style bonds
• Number puzzles: Tally sums, Cipher letter sums (cryptarithms) and Target arithmetic
• Dominoes: lay every tile so each coloured region keeps its rule
• Mines: clear a minefield by its numbers alone, never a guess
• Lamps: light every square, with no lamp shining on another
• Pearls: draw one loop through every black and white pearl
• Who's Who: match everyone to their house, pet and job from the clues
• Word puzzles: Lexicon (find the hidden word in a few guesses), Word Wheel, Codeword and a mini Crossword
• Codebreaker: crack a hidden colour code from scored guesses
• Mate: chess puzzles, mate in 2, 3 and 4
• Quick ones too: Pipes, Mosaic flood-fill, Trail one-line paths, Sand colour sorting, Sets, and Arrows, where every bump costs one of three lives

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? Ask for a hint and Daybook explains the next step in plain language, pointing at the squares it is talking about. You make the move yourself, so you learn the technique instead of watching it get filled in. Every puzzle has a one-minute walkthrough, and its rules are always one tap away.

LEVELS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Levels give you five boards from five different puzzles at a time; finish them and the next level opens. Achievements mark the milestones along the way, from your first Expert board to a week-long streak.

NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ACCOUNT.
There are no adverts, no paywall, no sign-in and no in-app purchases. The app does not even ask for network access, so these are true offline puzzles: they work on a plane, on a train and in a tunnel.

THE WHOLE ARCHIVE, FROM DAY ONE
Puzzles are made on your device from the date, so every past day is already there. Missed a week? Play it. Want more? Switch to Random boards at any difficulty.

KEEP YOUR STREAK
Track your daily streak, your times and your statistics, all stored privately on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Daybook collects nothing. No analytics, no trackers, no third-party SDKs. Your progress never leaves your device.

PHONES AND TABLETS
Turn your phone on its side or play on a tablet and the board sits beside the controls.

PLAY ANYWHERE
The same daily puzzles run in a web browser at knowhowit.com.au/daybook, no install needed.

Open source, with hand-built puzzle generators, proven boards and a calm, uncluttered design. Come back tomorrow for the next one.

featuredGames.name: AeroPayout
featuredGames.summary: Become a pilot in 7 days — buy tickets, advance seats, earn real rewards
featuredGames.description:
AeroPayout is an open-source social flight game where passengers advance toward
the pilot seat by referring new players and watching flights fill up.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Buy a ticket on any active flight using in-game coins.
2. Each new passenger who joins the same flight moves everyone one seat forward.
3. Reach seat #1 (the pilot seat) to earn a real coin payout.
4. Trade tickets on the in-game marketplace while the flight is still boarding.

MARKETPLACE
List your ticket for sale with a starting bid and optional Buy Now price.
Other players can bid in real time while the flight is in progress.
Auctions close automatically when the flight lands.

LIVE GLOBE
Watch all active flights on an interactive globe.
Track your seat position and estimated payout in real time.

OPEN SOURCE
AeroPayout is free software released under the GNU Affero General Public
License v3 (AGPL-3.0). The full source code — including the Android app and
the Odoo backend — is available in our public repository.

No ads. No tracking. No proprietary libraries.

REQUIREMENTS
An account on the AeroPayout server (free registration in the app).
Internet connection required for live flight data.

featuredGames.name: Flow: Connect Dots Puzzle
featuredGames.summary: Relax your brain with satisfying color line puzzles. Connect dots & clear boards
featuredGames.description: It is designed to test your logic! In this simple yet addictive color line puzzle, your goal is to connect dots of matching colours by drawing pipes. Fill the entire board to solve each level—but make sure your lines don't cross! Enjoy thousands of free stages in this offline puzzle game that you can play anywhere without Wi-Fi.

featuredGames.name: Cube Run
featuredGames.summary: Dodge, jump and slam through a neon 3-lane gauntlet. One-thumb 3D runner.
featuredGames.description:
Cube Run is a minimalist one-thumb 3D runner. The world rushes toward you down a neon three-lane track, and your cube has to dodge, jump, slide and slam its way through everything in the way.

Swipe left or right to snap between lanes, swipe up to leap low walls, swipe down to slide under overhead bars — or swipe down in mid-air to slam back to the ground in a hurry. Pillars and wide bars leave just one survivable lane, and once you get going some obstacles slide sideways into the open lane as they approach — so read the track and commit at the last moment.

Score a point for every row you clear, with a bonus for shaving past an obstacle by a hair. The track speeds up the longer you survive, the colours drift across the spectrum, and a single mistimed move ends the run in a burst of shards.

Features:

* One-thumb controls: swipe to switch lanes, jump, slide and slam.
* An endless, procedurally generated track — no two runs are alike.
* A relentless difficulty ramp that rewards nerve and near-misses.
* Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics.
* A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access.
* Tiny download and fully playable offline.

Cube Run is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

featuredGames.name: Ludo
featuredGames.description: Zero analytics, zero tracking, zero remote servers, and zero cloud sync. All gameplay stay exclusively on your local device. Offline game.

featuredGames.name: King Pong
featuredGames.summary: Retro Pong campaign with multiplayer and a secret ending
featuredGames.description:
King Pong is a retro arcade Pong game with an 18-level campaign, custom games, local and LAN multiplayer, progressive paddle shapes, save slots, multiple languages, touch controls, controller support, and a secret ending.

Features:
* 18 campaign levels across three leagues
* Custom games and local two-player mode
* Optional LAN multiplayer
* Progressive paddle shapes and changing arenas
* Touch, keyboard, and controller support
* Multiple languages and three local save slots
* Original programmatically generated music and sound
* Secret boss battle and ending

King Pong works offline and contains no advertising, analytics, accounts, tracking, or in-app purchases.

featuredGames.name: Planes Android
featuredGames.summary: Planes Android is a variant of the Battleships game for Android
featuredGames.description:
Position your planes on your game board and guess where the computer has hidden its before it guesses where you have hidden yours.

Starting with version 0.4.0 a multiplayer module is available as well.

The open-source app is also available for Windows and Linux.

featuredGames.name: Colorbook : Drawing for Kids
featuredGames.summary: Safe offline doodle and coloring book for toddlers.
featuredGames.description:
It is a simple, creative, and completely safe digital sketchbook designed specifically for toddlers, preschoolers, and young children.

Because i believe kids' creativity shouldn't be interrupted by ads or paywalls, this app is 100% Free and Open Source, runs entirely offline, and collects zero personal data.

featuredGames.name: Queens
featuredGames.summary: Challenging crown-placement logic puzzle. Infinite levels. No tracking & ads.
featuredGames.description:
Queens is a challenging crown-placement logic puzzle game where you place queens on a grid of colored regions.

How to play:
- Place exactly one queen in each row.
- Place exactly one queen in each column.
- Place exactly one queen in each colored region.
- Queens cannot touch each other, even diagonally (no adjacent placements).

Why you'll love it:

🚫 NO ADS, EVER
No banners. No interstitials. No rewarded videos. Just pure, uninterrupted gameplay.

📊 ZERO TRACKERS
No analytics. No data collection. No tracking of any kind. Your gameplay is yours alone.

♾️ INFINITE LEVELS
Procedurally generated random puzzle sizes from 5x5 up to 9x9, plus 150+ structured progression levels that scale all the way up to a massive 16x16 grid.

🔒 COMPLETELY OFFLINE
No internet permission required. Your progress is saved locally using high-performance Hive persistence. Play anywhere, anytime.

featuredGames.name: Wortmühle
featuredGames.summary: Daily German word puzzle — 9 or 8 letters, one pangram, fully offline
featuredGames.description:
Wortmühle ("word mill") is a daily German word puzzle: build as many German words as you can from nine (or eight) letters on the 3×3 mill board. Every word must use the center letter, and every puzzle contains at least one pangram — a word using all the letters.

Features:

• One new puzzle every day, with the last seven days replayable
• Two daily puzzles: 9 and 8 letters — 2500 nine-letter and 3000 eight-letter puzzles built in, fully offline
• Scoring with own letter values (1–4), with a pangram bonus
• Tap a found word for its definition — bundled, no network needed
• Light/dark mode selectable (follows the system otherwise)
• No permissions, no tracking, no ads, no accounts, no Google services

The app requests no permissions at all and never touches the network. The definitions ship with it: they come from de.wiktionary.org, are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and are shortened to the first two senses. Each definition carries a link to its Wiktionary page — tapping it opens your browser.

Note: the game and its vocabulary are entirely in German. The word list is derived from free sources (igerman98 word list, de.wiktionary, OpenSubtitles frequency data).

featuredGames.name: Chogan
featuredGames.summary: Offline games: chess, sudoku, solitaire, pool, air hockey and more. No ads.
featuredGames.description:
Chogan is a collection of small, finishable games in one app: more than forty, with new ones arriving as updates.

The games:

* Tower Defence — four towers, six maps, twenty waves
* Sudoku — four difficulties, one solution each, notes and hints
* Minesweeper — no-guess generation, four sizes, chording and flags
* Dots and Boxes — two players on one phone, or against the AI
* Backgammon — two players or against the AI, gammons count double
* Mancala — Kalah rules, two players or against the AI
* Nonogram — three sizes, every puzzle solvable by logic alone
* FreeCell — the classic numbered deals, never the one unwinnable deal
* Reversi — two players or against the AI
* Nine Men's Morris — two players or against the AI
* Peg Solitaire — leave one peg, in the centre for a perfect game
* Battleship — against an AI that never cheats
* Bridges — three sizes, every puzzle with exactly one solution
* Code Breaker — three levels, colour-blind friendly
* Breakout — twelve fixed levels, three balls each
* Pasur — the Persian fishing card game, against the AI
* Mahjong Solitaire — three layouts including the turtle, every deal solvable
* Chess — against the AI or two players, plus Lichess puzzles
* Hokm — the Persian four-player card game, with an AI partner
* Block Drop — falling blocks: a 40-line sprint or a 100-line marathon
* Gomoku — five in a row on 9, 13 or 15 lines
* Go — 9×9 Go with automatic counting, against the AI or two players
* Way Out — send every arrow off the board in a working order
* Blackjack — closer to 21 than the dealer, ten-hand matches with no betting
* 8-Ball Pool — pot your group, then the 8
* Snooker — reds and colours, then the colours in order; 6, 10 or 15 reds
* Gridlock — slide the cars aside and drive yours out of the lot
* Chain Reaction — add orbs until cells burst in chains; 2 to 4 players or bots
* Ludo — come out on a six and race your tokens home; 2 to 4 players or bots
* Snakes and Ladders — first to 100; 2 to 4 players or bots
* Darts — 501 or 301, finish on a double; against a bot or two players
* Bowling — ten frames, swipe to bowl
* Sliding Puzzle — slide the numbered tiles back into order, from 3×3 to 5×5
* Jigsaw — 12 to 150 pieces, on Persian patterns and scenes drawn in code
* Checkers — classic, Spanish or Huevo Style rules, AI or two players
* Klondike — classic solitaire, draw one or three
* Crazy Eights — match the suit or rank, Iranian or international rules
* Gin Rummy — melds and deadwood against a bot, a match to 100
* Shelem — Hokm with bidding: take the widow, name trump, a match to 505
* Spider — two decks; one, two or four suits
* Pairs — the memory game: turn two cards at a time and find every pair
* Gorillas — exploding bananas across a city: angle, power and wind
* Hop — bounce from platform to platform without falling; touch or tilt to steer
* Tanks — fire across the hills with five weapons; a bot or two players
* Chinese chess — xiangqi with palace, cannons, elephants and flying generals
* Ping Pong — table tennis from above, first to 11; a bot or two players
* Air Hockey — a neon table, first to seven goals; a bot or two players
* Echo — the coloured pads light up; repeat the order, one more each round
* Lights Off — every light switches its neighbours too; put them all out
* Corridor — walk your pawn across and block the other with walls

Around the games:

* A daily challenge that is identical on every device, with no server at all
* A weekly offline league with five tiers
* Over 150 awards
* Stats and a profile
* Persian, English, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish and Polish interface with light and dark themes

On privacy:

* The only permission the app declares is vibration. Not even internet access
* No ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics, no tracking
* Everything ships inside the package; even the sound is made in code
* Progress is stored on the device only, and Google auto-backup is turned off

Free and open source under the MIT licence.
